# Criteri ESG

> Criteri ESG is a service that synthesizes European institutional ESG reports into 8 actionable blocks for sustainability directors, compliance officers, and ESG consultants. Each report includes a Methodological Semaphore (A-D grade), 5 key data points, executive summary, implications, connections, recommended actions, and cross-references with EcoVadis, B Corp, MSCI ESG, and GRI frameworks.

## Services
- ESG report library (processed with 8 blocks): https://criteriesg.com/informes
- Bimonthly ESG newsletter
- Cross-reference with EcoVadis, B Corp, MSCI ESG, GRI certifications
- Methodological Semaphore: quality assessment of ESG reports (A-D grade)
- "Beyond the Checkbox": ethical editorial analysis from Mediterranean perspective

## Areas of expertise
- CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive)
- ESRS (European Sustainability Reporting Standards)
- EcoVadis methodology and ratings
- B Corp certification (B Lab Standards V2.1)
- MSCI ESG ratings
- GRI Standards (Global Reporting Initiative)
- TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures)
- TNFD (Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures)
- SFDR (Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation)
- CSDDD (Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive)
- EU Taxonomy
- ISO 14001
- UN Global Compact / SDGs

## Languages
- Catalan (default)
- Spanish
- Both languages available on all pages via language toggle

- Free: newsletter + 3 reports/month + reports older than 6 months
